method: Densify source linework at maximum 0.01-degree segment length, per-site WGS84 azimuthal equidistant projection, shortest planar point-to-line distance; approximate geometric proximity, not routed connection length.
epoch_note: Dataset title refers to 2018; catalog release year 2021 and metadata update 2025 do not establish current operational status.
independence_note: Catalogue describes DRC EASE mapping revised with SNEL specialists; it is an infrastructure context, not an independent validation of road coverage or energy reliability.
exclusions: No inference of energization, connection, voltage compatibility, spare capacity, reliability, tariff or economic sovereignty.
